disclosures.text: A pull-down fastening device for fastening objects with bores
The device comprises a fastening unit
The fastening unit features a modular interchangeable fastening insert
The modular interchangeable fastening insert includes a fastening element

A pull-down fastening device for fastening objects with bores, comprising a fastening unit featuring a modular interchangeable fastening insert, wherein the modular interchangeable fastening insert includes a fastening element
The device has several varied fastening inserts
The fastening element is firmly connected with the fastening insert
The fastening element is movably connected with the fastening insert
The fastening element is swivelably connected with the fastening insert
The fastening element can swivel about an axis perpendicular to the direction of fastening
The fastening insert is equipped for replacement into the starting position when fastening is released
The fastening element includes a fastening ring
The fastening element includes a tie-rod
The fastening element includes a tapered insertable collar
The tapered insertable collar has a taper designed to interact with the fastening ring
The device has a bushing for the tapered insertable collar
The bushing ensures a secure fit of the tapered insertable collar
The bushing enables an adjustment to the tapered insertable collar
The bushing enables a one-dimensional adjustment to the tapered insertable collar
The bushing enables a two-dimensional adjustment to the tapered insertable collar
The fastening unit has a drive piston
The drive piston is a hydraulic drive piston
The drive piston is arranged parallel to the fastening element
The drive piston is mechanically coupled with the fastening insert
The drive piston is positively coupled with the fastening insert
The drive piston is coupled with the fastening insert by means of a pin
